input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation provision in the Agreement (§ 7.6) runs in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to us will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. Targeted searches of the Fees section, General, Agreement Structure and Scope, and the whole document (best pricing, no less favourable, match a third-party offer, parity/right to match) found no obligation requiring Customer to extend Vendor terms given to third parties. The preferred position — no MFN obligation on Customer, with Vendor-granted MFN pricing welcome — is therefore met, and per the direction guidance we do not redline a clause that benefits us.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
